_comment: Ground truth for the detection benchmark. Images are NOT committed: see eval/README.md. 'label' is pothole, not_pothole or unlabelled. 'labelled_by' matters: only the six photos were confirmed by the project owner. Everything marked UNVERIFIED is the assistant's own judgment and has not been reviewed by a human, including all four negatives that the false-positive rate is measured against. Treat rates computed against unverified labels as provisional.
